title: Weak sequential session IDs in dvwaSession cookie
description: The /vulnerabilities/weak_id/ endpoint generates predictable sequential integers as session identifiers (dvwaSession=1, 2, 3...). An attacker can enumerate session IDs and hijack active sessions.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/weak_id/; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=1 Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=2 Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=3 Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=4 Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=5
proof:
Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=1
Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=2
Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=3
Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=4
Set-Cookie: dvwaSession=5
